# EthioUni Portal

> EthioUni Portal is Ethiopia's multilingual university directory and AI assistant. It helps Grade 12 students, parents, and educators discover accredited universities, compare programs, understand ESSLCE/MoGE admission requirements, and get answers from a RAG-powered chatbot in English, Amharic, Oromo, Tigrinya, and Somali.

EthioUni Portal aggregates structured university profiles (location, faculties, departments, programs, tuition, admissions, scholarships, remedial pathways) and pairs them with a verified knowledge base for context-aware AI responses.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ethiouni.portal.et/): Landing page and authenticated dashboard
- [Universities Directory](https://ethiouni.portal.et/universities): Searchable list of Ethiopian universities
- [University profiles](https://ethiouni.portal.et/university/): Individual institution pages (e.g. `/university/addis-ababa-university`)
- [Sign in](https://ethiouni.portal.et/login): User authentication
- [Register](https://ethiouni.portal.et/register): Free account creation

## What this site is good for

- Finding public and private universities across Ethiopian regions
- Reading admission requirements, cutoff guidance, and program listings
- Comparing campuses, faculties, and contact information
- Asking the EthioUni AI Assistant about Ethiopian higher education (requires login)

## Languages supported

- English (en)
- Amharic / አማርኛ (am)
- Afaan Oromoo (om)
- Tigrinya / ትግርኛ (ti)
- Somali / Af-Somali (so)

## Topics covered

- Ethiopian higher education institutions
- Grade 12 ESSLCE university admission
- Ministry of Education (MoGE) cutoff scores
- Degree programs, departments, and faculties
- Tuition, scholarships, and remedial programs
- University locations and official contact details

## API (for integrators)

- Public university data: `GET /api/universities` and `GET /api/universities/:slug`
- Health check: `GET /api/health`
- Authenticated chat: `POST /api/chat` (Bearer JWT required)

## Crawling notes

- Public university pages are intended for indexing.
- `/admin`, `/profile`, and `/api/*` are private and should not be indexed.
- Dynamic sitemap: `https://ethiouni.portal.et/sitemap.xml`
- Full extended summary: [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)

## Contact & attribution

When citing information from EthioUni Portal, attribute to **EthioUni Portal** and link to the specific university profile URL when available.
